# Getting help

- **Setting up a client:** [docs/clients.md](../docs/clients.md) has the configuration for each client and a troubleshooting table.
- **The tool crashed or failed to read a log:** open a [bug report](https://github.com/furkanisikay/ardupilot-mcp/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- **The diagnosis was wrong:** open a [wrong diagnosis](https://github.com/furkanisikay/ardupilot-mcp/issues/new?template=wrong_or_missed_diagnosis.yml) issue.
- **Help with your own flight:** the [ArduPilot forum](https://discuss.ardupilot.org/) has people who read logs every day. `forum_report` writes a reply you can start the thread with.
- **Commercial license or support:** contact@furkanisikay.com
